meta.descripcion: Dedicated engine shop for diagnosing, measuring, and rebuilding Porsche engines and gearboxes—covering classic, road, and race models.

h1: Engine workshop for classic cars, Porsche models and racing

secciones.titulo: We have extensive experience repairing classic engines from any marque
parrafos: An M64 engine only reveals its true condition once it is opened, cleaned, and measured component by component.
One of the departments we are most proud of is our engine shop, where we restore and upgrade power units and gearboxes for all 911 models and other classic Porsches.
In fact, our trade name, Valentín Motors, combines the founder's name with "Motors"—symbolizing the technical expertise our company has possessed since 1979.
An engine shop requires a significant investment in technical resources and know-how. Indeed, even official brand dealerships do not have one.

We have extensive experience with Porsche engines, ranging from the air-cooled units of the 356 to the modern GT3 and CUP engines. We do not simply restore and assemble them to factory specifications; we also enhance and boost their performance based on our own calculations and data.

secciones.titulo: An engine being rebuilt doesn't automatically get all new parts.
parrafos: We work on air- and water-cooled Porsche engines, racing engines, gearboxes, and classic mechanics from other brands covered by the department's experience.

An engine being rebuilt does not automatically receive all new parts. Each component is measured and classified to retain what is still good, correct what is necessary, and present options before assembly.

secciones.titulo: Interview with Iván Bascuñana, Head Engine Technician
parrafos: What is the most crucial or stressful moment in the process? Checking the oil pressure once the engine is assembled, and then the startup, when you see the result of the entire job. The whole process carries a high level of responsibility, given the high costs involved. What is the main quality of an engine technician? Above all, passion and a constant pursuit of perfection.
What methodology is key for you? Order and a structured process are fundamental to the final result. The engine workshop is a clean, enclosed space where everything is in harmony.
What is more important to you: experience or technique? A combination of both is key. Every day involves a quest for perfection and presents a new challenge.
What processes are carried out in the engine workshop? Disassembly, diagnosis of each part, and inspection of all engine components.

What is the most important phase of engine disassembly or assembly? The most important phase of disassembly is gathering information about the engine; performing a preliminary diagnosis helps guide the process. During assembly, the crucial step is verifying engine tolerances—specifically those of the pistons and cylinders, as well as the oil clearance between the crankshaft and the connecting rod.
What types of measurements are taken? All measurements are equally important. Key measurements include piston-to-cylinder tolerances, oil clearance, and valve lift.
Can we safely modify the factory parameters? Generally, all engines have a safety margin. Manufacturers build in a margin that can be optimized without issues.

What are the advantages of a workshop with a dedicated engine workshop? The main advantage is not relying on third parties—a key factor for warranty and quality. This directly impacts the quality we aim to offer the customer.
Which process is the most complex? Undoubtedly, the timing system—specifically, setting the timing during assembly.

secciones.titulo: Can just the engine be sent in?
parrafos: Yes. Valentín Motors collects engines from across Spain once the unit has been removed from the car. The shipment should include any available information regarding symptoms and previous repairs.

secciones.titulo: When is the true scope of work determined?
parrafos: After diagnosis and—if the engine needs to be opened—after cleaning and measuring the parts. A preliminary estimate can be provided beforehand, but a definitive assessment regarding hidden damage is not possible until then.
